functions.name: email
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.email()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.email', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'email')
  )::text
$function$

functions.name: check_is_order_candidate_rider
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_order_candidate_rider(p_order_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.rider_assignments ra
        INNER JOIN public.riders r ON r.id = ra.rider_id
        WHERE ra.order_id = p_order_id AND r.user_id = p_user_id
    );
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.admins
    WHERE email = auth.email() AND is_active = true
  );
$function$
